column3: Traffic Alert for Bowman Mill Road:
column4: The roadway is closed to thru traffic between Old Harrodsburg Rd and Parkers Mill Rd due to high water.
Currently in effect until Oct. 7 at 6:30 p.m.
Includes Bourbon, Clark, Fayette, Franklin, Harrison, Jessamine, Mercer, Nicholas, Scott and Woodford Co's.
Do not drive through areas of high water.  Be safe and turn around.
